title: Source-grounded hybrid extraction of construction procurement documents: evaluation harness, labels and reference implementation
description: Reference implementation, evaluation harness, 20 hand-verified golden labels, the 26-document replication corpus manifest, raw run outputs, analysis scripts and two human-study instruments, supporting the manuscript "Source-grounded hybrid extraction of decision-critical information from construction procurement documents". The workflow requires every surfaced value to be locatable in the source text and validates monetary arithmetic before a value is shown. The deployed web application is deliberately excluded; it forms no part of the reported method.
